generation.explanation: Two functions are inverses when each one undoes the other. On a graph, that means swapping x and y: every point (a, eᵃ) on y = eˣ matches a point (eᵃ, a) on y = ln(x). Swapping coordinates is the same as reflecting across the line y = x, so the graph of ln(x) is the mirror image of eˣ. Move the slider and you'll see that the segment from P to Q always crosses y = x at a right angle, and its midpoint always sits on that line.
